email_body:
Dear Radisson Hotel Group Team,

I am writing to apply for the Receptionist Day & Night role. Your promise that Every Moment Matters and the Yes I Can! spirit resonate with me. While my background is in digital marketing and web development, I have always enjoyed working with people and creating positive experiences. I am fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have a good command of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+). I am patient, empathetic, and a creative problem-solver. I thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy collaborating with a team to ensure guest satisfaction. I am flexible and ready to work day and night shifts. I would love to bring my energy and dedication to your Front Office team and help make every moment matter for your guests.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Receptionist Day & Night position at Radisson Hotel Group. Your brand promise, Every Moment Matters, and the Yes I Can! service ethos immediately caught my attention. Although my professional background is in digital marketing and web development, I have always been drawn to roles that involve direct interaction and creating positive experiences for people. I believe my blend of technical skills and people-oriented mindset makes me a strong candidate for this role.

In my current freelance work and as a junior digital marketer, I collaborate with clients and team members to deliver results. I have developed strong communication skills, patience, and a creative approach to problem-solving. For example, I built and optimized websites for clients, which required careful attention to detail and a proactive attitude. I am comfortable working in fast-paced environments and enjoy the hustle and bustle of a dynamic team. I am fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have a good command of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+). I am eager to improve my Dutch further and am confident in my ability to communicate effectively with guests.

What draws me to hospitality is the opportunity to make a real difference in someone’s day. I am flexible, positive, and ready to work day and night shifts. I understand that a receptionist is the face of the hotel and the first point of contact for guests. I am committed to delivering exceptional service and ensuring that every guest feels welcome and valued. I am a quick learner and am excited to bring my Yes I Can! attitude to the Front Office team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to the Radisson Hotel Group team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
